title: Per-MCE upgrade settings (upgrade/mces/<mce>.yaml)
description: Git is intent, the cluster is truth: supportedHostedVersions must equal the hypershift/supported-versions ConfigMap on that MCE, which the workflow checks before every run. The file name is the MCE's name and must match a sites/*/mces/<mce>/ directory.

supportedHostedVersions.description: OCP minors this MCE's HyperShift operator can host, quoted ("4.22"); an unquoted 4.20 is a YAML float.

maxConcurrentControlPlanes.description: How many hosted control planes on this MCE may upgrade at the same time.
